column1: # 9장 말투 지시. 열: 조각 앞머리 → 지시(영어, 짧게). @scene 행은 장면 설명. 장부·편지·일기(@letter)는 지시하지 않는다.

column2: Thursday, very early, in Montse's kitchen. Montse, the warm landlady, notices Yuna can't sleep and guesses it is because of Marc's boxes. Yuna uses the reflexive "me levanto" and reflects on what it literally means. Gentle, a little teasing.
surprised and affectionate, a light question

column1: No. Me levanto a las seis
column2: careful, a beginner, trying the new verb
knowing, a gentle tease; she already guesses

Marc's locksmith workshop. Marc gives Yuna an old button phone and jokes dryly that everything in his workshop is old. He opened one of his grandfather Martí's boxes last night and found a ledger: an October 1978 grandfather clock "for S., not for sale". Yuna wonders if S. is her grandmother Sun-rye. Hushed discovery, then Marc must go to work and asks her along.
polite, then honest and a little amused
low and tired; he means last night
almost whispering, a hopeful question; she is asking if S. is her grandmother

column1: Ahora tengo trabajo. En el Born

column2: dry, a hint of care hidden in it

column1: @scene El Born은 고딕 지구 바로 옆
column2: Marc repairs a huge old wooden door in the Born, with Yuna as his assistant. He names tools (destornillador, martillo, tornillo) and she learns them by handing them over. He asks about her life in Korea; she describes her old office day with reflexive verbs, and then her new, simpler day. Marc smiles silently. Quiet, warming.

column1: El Born은 고딕 지구 바로 옆

column2: brief, focused on work, asking for the tool
confused, she doesn't know the word "destornillador"

column1: 한 시간 동안 나는 마르크의 조수였다

column2: low, casual, eyes on the lock
plain, a little flat, a beginner

column1: ¿Y cómo es un día en la oficina?
Me levanto a las seis. Me ducho
column2: careful beginner, listing her old routine; "Trabajo" three times, flatter each time
softly, looking straight at her, a real question

After the job, Yuna shows Marc a line she read in Martí's first letter: Sunday, eleven o'clock, Santa Maria del Mar. He takes her to the church nearby. They sit at the back in silence; she says her grandmother was here once, and he adds that so was his grandfather. Hushed, intimate.
careful, reading from her notebook, a real question
